meta.title: Nina Marquina — Architecture & Interiors in El Hatillo, Caracas
meta.description: Boutique architecture and interior design studio specialising in colonial restoration, sustainable design and high-end renovations in El Hatillo, Caracas, with projects in Punta Cana.
meta.keywords: Architect in Caracas, Interior design Caracas, Colonial restoration Venezuela, Architect in Venezuela, Custom kitchens and walk-in closets, Architecture Punta Cana, 3D visualization

hero.title: Designing for the life that happens after.

philosophy.label: Our philosophy
philosophy.title: Spaces take on meaning when they begin to be lived in.
philosophy.body: We understand architecture as a way of connecting people, places and stories. We design sustainable, climate-sensitive spaces that endure, evolve and find their true identity in the people who live in them.
philosophy.imageAlt: Clay amphora with an olive tree beside a wooden door

beforeAfter.label: Transformations
beforeAfter.title: Recovering what matters, living in it again.
beforeAfter.body: Drag to compare the original state of a colonial house in El Hatillo with its final restoration.
beforeAfter.handle: Drag to compare before and after
beforeAfter.beforeAlt: Colonial living room before restoration, with deteriorated walls
beforeAfter.afterAlt: Restored colonial living room with timber beams and terracotta floor

mirada.label: Perspective
mirada.title: Some places deserve a new story.
mirada.body: We are drawn to architecture that knows how to look back while moving forward. Recovering what is valuable, reinterpreting what exists and creating new ways of living through conscious design.
mirada.imageAlt: Stone bench and antique wooden door in a colonial house

studio.label: The studio
studio.title: A personal practice of architecture.
studio.body: Nina Marquina, architect and civil engineer, leads a studio that approaches every project with sensitivity to place, material and the people who inhabit it: sustainability, high-end renovations and bespoke design of kitchens, walk-in closets and furniture.
studio.image1Alt: Architectural plans and material samples on a desk
studio.image2Alt: Wooden shelf with books and a potted olive tree
